extDescription.message: Send your browser's downloads to WingHarness, cookies and all — with a right-click or automatically.

optionsSubtitle.message: Send downloads from your browser to WingHarness.

pairingDesc.message: Match these to WingHarness's Settings → Browser integration. Copy the access token from there and paste it below.

enabledDesc.message: The master switch for this extension.

autoDesc.message: Intercept the browser's own downloads and hand them to WingHarness. Off by default — right-click → “Download with WingHarness” works either way.

footerNote.message: Settings save as you change them. WingHarness must be running for capture to work — the extension can't start it for you.

aboutProjectDesc.message: Download capture for the WingHarness desktop app.

aboutRepository.message: Open the WingHarness repository on GitHub

aboutUpstreamDesc.message: The download-capture flow and the original icon come from moin, an open-source download manager, under the MIT license.

aboutUpstreamRepository.message: Open the moin repository on GitHub

statusBadToken.message: Reached WingHarness, but the token is wrong

statusUnreachable.message: Couldn't reach WingHarness — is it running?

promptBody.message: Start WingHarness, then send it this download.

notifyNothingBody.message: That link isn't a direct file WingHarness can fetch.

notifyResolveTitle.message: Couldn't resolve the final download URL

notifyResolveBody.message: The browser will continue this download. Try again after the page finishes redirecting.

notifyNotSetUpBody.message: Open the extension's options and paste WingHarness's access token.

notifyNotRunningBody.message: Start WingHarness, then try this download again.

notifyBadTokenBody.message: Regenerate it in WingHarness and update the extension's options.
